messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: INC-9812 -> lb-target-health spike in us-west-2. Page sent to @maya and @jonas. Auto-escalation rules in effect.
maya (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — stopping non-essential batch jobs and checking logs.
jonas (sre): I'm seeing TLS handshake failures from ALB to targets, lots of 502/504 hits. ALB console shows several targets Unhealthy. Pulling target healthcheck output now.
olivia (netops): Any recent ALB or cert changes pushed in the last hour? I don't see config pushes in CloudTrail.
maya (oncall): No cert rotations on my side. Carter, do customers see full outage or degraded?
carter (support): Support ticket flood. Many inference endpoints returning 5xx starting ~12:09 UTC. Severity elevated to S2; multiple customers reporting retries.
jonas (sre): Paste of ALB health snippet:
```
ALB: TargetResponseCode: 0, TargetFailureReason: TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE
Target: ip-10-0-4-12 -> failed 4/4
Target: ip-10-0-4-13 -> failed 3/4
```
maya (oncall): Doing an in-cluster curl to one target from a bastion: 
```
curl -v https://10.0.4.12:443 --resolve app.internal:443:10.0.4.12
* Connected to 10.0.4.12 (10.0.4.12) port 443 (#0)
* SSL connection failed: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
```
jonas (sre): Hypothesis: partial OpenSSL/crypto patch rolled to some instances causing cipher mismatch with ALB's TLS policy. I'm checking package history and rpm/dpkg logs.
olivia (netops): For fast mitigation I can temporarily relax the ALB cipher policy to permit older ciphers and see if targets recover. That'll lower crypto posture but speeds recovery. Thoughts?
maya (oncall): Let's avoid lowering crypto if we can. Alternative: bring up warm backup instances in the fallback ASG that haven't had the patch and shift some traffic. Jonas — can you spin up new targets and register to TG?
jonas (sre): Spun up 3 warm instances (ami: inference-warm-202501) and registered to target group tg-inference-usw2-1. Health checks passing. Logs show successful TLS handshake from ALB now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9812 auto-escalated to @sre-shift-lead due to >10m ack delay.
sre-shift-lead: Oncoming. Good work. Proceed with weighted failover to new instances, monitor 5xx rate and customer reports. Also open a revert/change ticket for the package causing TLS mismatch.
maya (oncall): Rolling weighted routing: shifting 30% -> new targets, checking metrics. 5xx rate down 60% in the last 4 minutes.
carter (support): Customer-facing update posted: "We are mitigating an elevated error rate impacting some inference requests in us-west-2. We've shifted traffic and expect service quality to stabilize shortly."
jonas (sre): Mitigation complete: new targets handling steady traffic, ALB target health green. Will start cordoning and reprovisioning older instances to align OpenSSL versions, then re-register.
maya (oncall): Handoff to @sre-shift-lead at 12:40 UTC for follow-up/root cause. I'll stay available for support comms.
sre-shift-lead: Confirmed. Tasks: 1) postmortem draft, 2) roll back patch on affected pool or update ALB cipher policy as documented, 3) add preflight check for OpenSSL upgrades, 4) lower DNS TTL for quicker cutovers next time.
carter (support): Noting follow-ups and will keep customers updated. ETA full recovery marked 12:52 UTC; monitoring.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9812 status changed to monitoring at 12:52 UTC.
